chunks.title: LCEL — compose Runnables with |
chunks.text: LCEL (LangChain Expression Language) pipes Runnables: `chain = prompt | model | parser`. Invoke with `chain.invoke(input)`, stream with `chain.stream(input)`, batch with `chain.batch([..])`. Inputs/outputs follow each Runnable's schema. Prefer LCEL over LLMChain. JavaScript: `prompt.pipe(model).pipe(parser)` or the `RunnableSequence` helper.

chunks.title: Chat models and init_chat_model
chunks.text: Install a partner package (`pip install langchain-openai`) or call `init_chat_model("openai:gpt-4.1-mini")`. Messages use `SystemMessage` / `HumanMessage` / `AIMessage`. `model.invoke(messages)` returns an `AIMessage`. Do not import `ChatOpenAI` from `langchain.chat_models`. Tool binding: `model.bind_tools(tools)`.

chunks.title: Agents replace initialize_agent
chunks.text: `create_agent(model, tools)` builds a tool-calling agent. Invoke with `{"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}`. LangGraph's `create_react_agent` is the graph equivalent. `initialize_agent` and `AgentType.ZERO_SHOT_REACT_DESCRIPTION` are removed. Define tools with `@tool` from `langchain_core.tools`.

chunks.title: RAG without RetrievalQA
chunks.text: Index `Document`s into a vector store, expose `.as_retriever()`, then `create_stuff_documents_chain` + `create_retrieval_chain`. `RetrievalQA.from_chain_type` and `ConversationalRetrievalChain` are deprecated. Splitters: `RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter`. Embeddings come from partner packages (`OpenAIEmbeddings`).

chunks.title: LangChain.js package layout
chunks.text: Core: `@langchain/core`. OpenAI: `@langchain/openai`. LangGraph: `@langchain/langgraph`. Import `ChatOpenAI` from `@langchain/openai`, not `langchain/chat_models`. Build LCEL with `.pipe()`. Agents: `createReactAgent` from `@langchain/langgraph/prebuilt`.

chunks.title: VectorStoreIndex and Settings
chunks.text: `from llama_index.core import VectorStoreIndex, SimpleDirectoryReader, Settings, Document`. Set `Settings.llm` and `Settings.embed_model` instead of `ServiceContext`. `index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents(docs)`; query with `index.as_query_engine().query(...)`; multi-turn with `index.as_chat_engine()`.

chunks.title: Split packages (0.10+)
chunks.text: `pip install llama-index` pulls core. LLMs: `llama-index-llms-openai`, `llama-index-llms-ollama`. Embeddings: `llama-index-embeddings-openai`, `llama-index-embeddings-ollama`. `from llama_index import GPTSimpleVectorIndex` fails — that name is gone. Use `llama_index.core`.

chunks.title: FunctionAgent workflow
chunks.text: Current agents live in `llama_index.core.agent.workflow` (`FunctionAgent`, `AgentWorkflow`, `ReActAgent`). Wrap callables or use `FunctionTool`. Wrap a query engine with `QueryEngineTool.from_defaults(query_engine)`. Older `llama_index.agent.openai.OpenAIAgent` import paths are stale.

chunks.title: Local models via Ollama
chunks.text: `from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama` and `from llama_index.embeddings.ollama import OllamaEmbedding`. Example: `Settings.llm = Ollama(model="llama3.2", request_timeout=120)` and `Settings.embed_model = OllamaEmbedding(model_name="nomic-embed-text")`. Pull both models with the Ollama CLI first.

chunks.title: Chat API vs generate
chunks.text: `POST /api/chat` body: `{ "model": "llama3.2", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"..."}], "stream": false }`. Python: `ollama.chat(...)`. JS: `ollama.chat({model, messages})`. `/api/generate` takes `prompt` (not `messages`). OpenAI-compatible: `http://localhost:11434/v1` with a local model tag.

chunks.title: CLI: pull, run, list
chunks.text: `ollama pull llama3.2` downloads a tag. `ollama run llama3.2` chats in the terminal. `ollama list` shows local models. `ollama serve` starts the daemon on `11434`. `OLLAMA_HOST` overrides bind address. `llama2` is no longer a safe default — pull an explicit tag.

chunks.title: Tool calling
chunks.text: Pass `tools` (OpenAI-style function JSON) into `/api/chat`. The response may include `message.tool_calls`. Append the assistant message, then a `role: tool` message with the function result, and call chat again. Quality varies by model (llama3.1+, qwen2.5, etc.).

chunks.title: Embeddings
chunks.text: `POST /api/embed` with `{ "model": "nomic-embed-text", "input": ["text"] }`. Python: `ollama.embed(model="nomic-embed-text", input=[...])`. Legacy `/api/embeddings` used `prompt`. Pull an embedding model separately from the chat model.
